jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/cap-reroute.diff (tools/swarm.mjs runOne admission step: an auto job refused with reason lane-cap is requeued on the next lane instead of held; cappedLanes feeds routeHealth). Rules: (1) the spend caps must never be bypassed: the re-routed job still passes reserveSpend on its new lane; run-cap must still hold; a job with a named lane must still hold; (2) no infinite loop or lost job: each lane is added to cappedLanes once, the requeue path must leave record, lane slot (release), reservation and `remaining` accounting consistent (compare with the existing retry path at the finally block: it does not call settle, mine returns early from the try before the later try/finally: check that settle/remaining/dependents are not left wrong, that waitingJobs/scheduler counters are not leaked); (3) a sensitive job must never be rerouted to a lane that is not allowed for it (routeJob handles it; confirm); (4) cappedLanes is per runManifest call: resume behaviour; (5) the state fields capFallbacks and spendWarnings: are they persisted and shown; any consumer that would choke on the new field; (6) the test: does it prove the new path runs, is it flaky. Report each problem as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW with file, line and a concrete failing scenario, and say what you checked that is fine. Do not edit files.
